facts.en: Awarded a Bachelor of Arts in geography by Fictional Juniper Reach College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年获虚构杜松岸学院颁发地理学文学学士学位。

facts.en: Enrolled in the Master of Environmental Studies programme at Fictional Sandglass University from 2022-09 to 2023-06.
facts.zh: 2022-09 至 2023-06 就读于虚构沙漏大学环境研究硕士项目。

facts.en: Completed 4 of the programme’s 10 taught modules before leaving; no dissertation was submitted and no master’s degree was awarded.
facts.zh: 离校前完成该项目 10 个授课模块中的 4 个；未提交论文，未获颁硕士学位。

facts.en: As of 2026-08, the candidate was not enrolled and no return date had been arranged.
facts.zh: 截至 2026-08，候选人未在读，且未安排返校日期。

facts.en: Paid stockroom assistant at Fictional Palefern Field Station from 2023-08 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-08 至 2026-08 在虚构淡蕨野外站任有薪库房助理。

facts.en: Maintained consumable stock cards and reconciled shelf counts with the ordering register.
facts.zh: 维护消耗品库存卡，并将货架盘点数量与订购登记表核对。

facts.en: Prepared reorder requests using thresholds set by the station manager.
facts.zh: 依据站点经理设定的阈值准备补货申请。

facts.en: Checked delivery quantities and reported damaged packaging without authorizing supplier payment.
facts.zh: 检查到货数量并报告包装破损，不授权供应商付款。

facts.en: Reorganized shelf-location codes in 2024-05 with the station technician.
facts.zh: 2024-05 与站点技术员共同调整货架位置编码。

facts.en: Personally wrote the location crosswalk; the technician decided storage compatibility.
facts.zh: 个人编写位置对照表；存储相容性由技术员决定。

facts.en: A 2024-06 spot check located 38 of 40 sampled items at the registered shelf; no earlier comparable check was available.
facts.zh: 2024-06 抽查中，40 个抽样物品有 38 个位于登记货架；无较早的可比抽查。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet lookups, filters and printed count sheets.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格查找、筛选及纸质盘点表。

facts.en: During the unfinished master’s programme, co-produced a classroom map of fictional sampling sites.
facts.zh: 在未完成的硕士项目期间，共同制作虚构采样点的课堂地图。

facts.en: The candidate formatted the map legend; classmates performed the spatial analysis, and the map was not used for field research.
facts.zh: 候选人排版地图图例；空间分析由同学完成，该地图未用于野外研究。

facts.en: Completed an internal stockroom safety induction in 2023-08; the induction was not a laboratory-practice certification.
facts.zh: 2023-08 完成内部库房安全入职培训；该培训不是实验室操作认证。

facts.en: Sent weekly stock-exception summaries to the station manager.
facts.zh: 每周向站点经理发送库存异常摘要。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Moss Post seed exchange in 2021, recording packet labels rather than conducting botanical experiments.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构苔邮种子交换活动中做志愿者，记录种子包标签，而非开展植物学实验。

facts.en: Made a personal illustrated seed-storage notebook in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年制作个人图解种子储存笔记。

facts.en: Enjoys walking and sketching imaginary coastlines.
facts.zh: 爱好步行及绘制想象中的海岸线。

facts.en: No postgraduate award, independent field-research role or laboratory sign-off authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录研究生层次学位、独立野外研究岗位或实验室签署批准权限。
